name: Razor Shark

features.name: Mystery stacks
features.description: Mystery stacks reveal matching symbols, sometimes with a Razor Reveal multiplier.

features.name: Free spins with progressive multiplier
features.description: Each reveal increases the multiplier during free spins.

review: Razor Shark uses mystery stacks that reveal symbols and, via the Razor Reveal, multipliers and cash. A 50,000x cap makes it a big step up from typical underwater slots, and the progressive multiplier gives bonuses a satisfying sense of momentum.
sources: Provider game sheet / in-game info screen (verify before launch)
